I need to think about this carefully. The question asks about an EastEnders actor who played policeman Nick Rowan on TV.

Nick Rowan was the main character in the TV series "Heartbeat," which ran from 1992-1998 for the character. This role was famously played by Nick Berry.

Nick Berry was indeed in EastEnders, where he played Simon Wicks (Wicksy) from 1985-1990 and briefly returned in 2012. After leaving EastEnders, he went on to star in Heartbeat as PC Nick Rowan.

Adam Woodyatt plays Ian Beale in EastEnders and has been with the show for decades, but he did not play Nick Rowan in Heartbeat.

Agent 2's answer of Nick Berry is correct. Agent 1's answer of Adam Woodyatt appears to be incorrect.
